items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Topics 40:1
items.html: As in the HGT, so in the NHY, only that which is above the screen can ascend; and since the screen of the NHY stands in their GAR, which are the three upper thirds, as above in Answer 112, therefore only the three upper thirds can ascend and join the three lower thirds of the HGT, to become HGT. But the three middle thirds, which are found below the screen, cannot be HGT, since they are already below the screen of the Sium. (There).
